title: Approximation Theorems for High-Dimensional Canonical U-Statistics: Gaussian Chaos and Phase Transition
summary: We study simultaneous inference for maxima of canonical order-two $U$-statistics in high dimension. Degeneracy makes quadratic fluctuations leading, so ordinary Gaussian calibration can fail even after exact variance normalization. We show that the appropriate general target is a joint signed Gaussian quadratic chaos and establish a general approximation result that permits indefinite kernels.
